assertions.assertion: The appeal is for the CO-197 denial
CPT 93229 is described as Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring
The appeal is for episode ep-05056
The service was medically necessary for this patient
The clinical indication note documents a history of recurrent syncope and palpitations
The concern is for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other cardiac arrhythmias
The submitted diagnosis codes are I49.9, I48.91, and R55
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture intermittent rhythm disturbances and correlate symptoms with electrocardiographic findings over an extended monitoring period
The request is for reconsideration of the precertification determination
The request is for payment of the outstanding balance of $615.60
